title: The Saint's Tongue
text: In a reliquary of black glass sits a tongue, pink and wet, that has not stopped praying in four hundred years. You can hear it if you lean close: a small, endless murmur. The glass is fogged on the inside from its breath, though it has no lungs.

options.label: The most devout kisses the glass.

outcomes.text: Their hands are warm for days after, and wounds close under them.
The tongue stops, and so does theirs. They will find their voice again after a fight or two.
It prays for you as you go, a little louder. You did not ask it to.
